text.headline: Timeline of Turkmenistan
text.text: Major events in the history of Turkmenistan.

events.headline: Seljuk Empire
events.text: Turkmen tribes establish the Seljuk Empire across Persia and the Middle East.

events.headline: Mongol Invasions
events.text: Genghis Khan’s forces devastate the region.

events.headline: Turkmen under Khanates
events.text: Turkmen nomads under Khiva, Bukhara, and Persian empires.

events.headline: Turkmen SSR
events.text: Becomes a Soviet republic within the USSR.

events.headline: Independence
events.text: Declares independence from the Soviet Union.

events.headline: Niyazov Presidency for Life
events.text: Authoritarian regime with a cult of personality.

events.headline: Serdar Berdimuhamedow Succeeds
events.text: Power passes from father to son.

events.headline: Energy & Neutrality Diplomacy
events.text: Expanding energy exports while promoting neutrality.
